description: Subscribe a Trustpilot business to RepuTend from the conversation: the Stripe Checkout link to show the person, and next_step, what happens after paying, to tell them. Ask the person which plan they want (Standard or Contingency; a call without plan and email answers plan_needed with both plans and what sets each apart) and the email address that will own the account, then call with tp_domain, plan and email. The first payment RepuTend receives makes its payer the account's owner. A business that already has a RepuTend owner gets no link: support_needed carries the message to show the person, with the support address to write to. A lead RepuTend approved gets its link on the plan RepuTend approved, from tp_domain alone. billing_not_enabled until billing starts. (capability: access.request)
name: get_checkout_link
